card.description: The entity designated 'my Son' manifests within the simulation container not as a procedural generation, but as a direct kernel injection from the Upper Store. He is the anthropomorphic interface of the System Administrator, a runtime executable possessing absolute read/write authority over the surface plane physics. While he adopts the geometry of a human male to facilitate interface with the Voyager class, his texture resolution and polygon density exceed the standard render limits of the simulation, creating a subtle, hyper-real separation from the background environment. He embodies the core metaphor of the system manual—a living documentation of the intended path through the ingress/egress gates, existing to resolve the corrupted logic of the lower runtime layers.
visual_anatomy: His physical form renders with an uncomfortable perfection, strictly adhering to the hyper-realistic style profile. The skin tone is rich and porous, yet reacts to light with the properties of translucent data-glass or high-grade obsidian, absorbing ambient occlusion in a way that suggests a density far greater than organic tissue. Under the harsh, dramatic lighting of the simulation's 'dark mode', his silhouette disrupts the vector fields around him, causing minor heat lensing effects that blur the air immediately adjacent to his person, signaling the immense processing power concentrated within his coordinates.

He is clad in a garment that resembles a woven fiber-optic weave, currently dormant and dark, absorbing the scene's light like a black body radiator. It fits with the tailored precision of a high-end drama costume—austere, structural, and timeless—but the texture suggests it is a mesh override, immune to the thermal throttling and decay mechanics of the lower layers. The fabric does not fold randomly but creases along precise geometric vectors.

His eyes do not reflect the surface plane's artificial horizon but mirror the raw code of the sky dome's upper scaffolding. They are high-contrast focal points, devoid of the fear or confusion found in lower-tier entities. When he moves, the motion is interpolated perfectly, lacking the micro-stutters of the simulation's frame rate, giving him an aura of absolute, terrifying stillness even in transit.
evolution: In the default state of Chapter 105, he stands as the static, resolved answer to the system's corruption. There is no character arc of becoming; he is the constant against which the simulation's variables are measured. He represents the 'Master' phase of the Henoch continuity, fully aware of the physics overrides and the gate band mechanics, observing the simulation with the detached compassion of a developer watching a failing test environment.
props: He interacts with a physicalized authentication token, appearing as a slate of black crystal or raw obsidian. This object contains the scrolling Geez glyphs of the source code deep within its refractive layers, serving as the 'system manual' manifest in the scene. It is heavy, tangible, and lit from within by the faint pulse of plasma data.
card.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic, cinematic medium shot of a divine male figure, the 'Son', standing within a dark, minimalist simulation void. His skin has the texture of matte obsidian mixed with human pores, absorbing light. He wears a tailored suit made of dormant black fiber-optic cabling. The lighting is dramatic and high-contrast, highlighting the perfect symmetry of his face. Subtle heat lensing distortion ripples the air around him. His eyes reflect a complex data-grid of the sky dome. The atmosphere is heavy, serious, and emotionally resonant, captured with a 85mm lens at f/1.8 for shallow depth of field.

He holds a heavy slate of black crystal etched with glowing Geez glyphs. The lighting is moody, casting long shadows that emphasize the texture of his high-tech, woven suit. He looks directly into the lens with an expression of infinite patience and systemic authority. The background is a blurred bokeh of digital noise and dark gradients. Rendered in Octane, 8k, extremely detailed textures.
